info.name: White Rose eTheses Online (OAI-PMH 2.0) Oai2 API

params.name: identifier
params.description: The unique OAI identifier of an item. Required for GetRecord; optional for ListMetadataFormats. Example oai:etheses.whiterose.ac.uk:411

params.name: metadataPrefix
params.description: The metadata format in which records should be returned. Required for GetRecord, ListRecords and ListIdentifiers unless resuming with a resumptionToken. oai_dc (simple Dublin Core) is the OAI-PMH mandatory baseline format.

params.name: from
params.description: Lower bound datestamp for selective harvesting (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ).

params.name: until
params.description: Upper bound datestamp for selective harvesting (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ).

params.name: set
params.description: Restricts a list request to records belonging to the given set.

params.name: resumptionToken
params.description: Flow control token from a previous incomplete list response. When supplied it is the only other argument allowed besides verb.

items.docs: Single OAI-PMH endpoint dispatched by the required `verb` parameter. Each verb accepts additional parameters per OAI-PMH 2.0. Responses are XML conforming to the OAI-PMH 2.0 schema.
